% tcolorbox titles that hold fragile commands, with the nameref package
% and without hyperref: \kind with \@ifstar, and \pick with \@ifnextchar.
% A numbered theorem, labelled or not, with a short title, and a box with
% nameref=, each set the title as the name that a \nameref gives.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage[most]{tcolorbox}
\usepackage{nameref}
\makeatletter
\newcommand\kind{\@ifstar{starred}{plain}}
\newcommand\pick{\@ifnextchar[{\pick@given}{x}}
\def\pick@given[#1]{#1}
\makeatother
\newtcbtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}{}{thm}
\newtcolorbox[auto counter]{named}[1]{nameref={#1}, title={Box \thetcbcounter: #1}, label=named}
\begin{document}
\begin{theorem}{Labelled \kind*}{one}Labelled.\end{theorem}
\begin{theorem}{Unlabelled \pick[u]}{}Unlabelled.\end{theorem}
\begin{theorem}[][Short \pick]{Long title}{short}With a short title.\end{theorem}
\begin{named}{Named \kind}A box with nameref.\end{named}

See Theorem~\ref{thm:one}, \ref{thm:short}, and Box~\ref{named}.
Named: \nameref{thm:one}; \nameref{thm:short}; \nameref{named}.
\end{document}
